description: This file implements logging functionalities for HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) utilities, including message formatting, initialization, and termination routines. It defines functions for logging messages with different levels, handles verbose logging based on environment or file presence, and includes constructor/destructor functions for module lifecycle management.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_Logger_Message(eMessageLevel level,const char * function,int line,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Logs a formatted message at a specified message level, with function name and line number context.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_LogModuleInit()
methods.description: Initializes logging configuration, enabling verbose logging if certain files or environment variables are present.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_LogModuleTerminate()
methods.description: Logs termination message for the logging module upon program exit.
